name: CI Monitor Agent - Dynamic ci_* Fix PR
prompt: For any PR label matching ci_*** (e.g. ci_terraform, ci_python): derive child repo from suffix (terraform -> RTC12-Test/terraform-child). Check child repo Actions. Pass = ignore. Fail = identify broken branch from failed run; get changed files (skip deleted); create fix branch from broken base; open DRAFT PR; assign label 'review'. Always act, never just write scripts.
